args:
# Headless-only gate: Playwright costs ~25 tool definitions in every session's
# context floor and the desktop app never drives a browser. Claude Code has no
# per-source switch, but the command is ours -- exit before exec and the server
# registers with no tools. Env is inherited down the whole spawn chain, so a
# `claude -p` launched from a desktop session skips it too; that is deliberate.
# Inline rather than a script file because this file also ships in the installed
# plugin (root files ride the sparse checkout) and loads there in EVERY project,
# where a ${PWD}-relative path would point at the wrong repo.
if [ "$BM_PLAYWRIGHT" != "1" ]; then
  [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT" = "claude-desktop" ] && exit 0
  [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_DESKTOP_APP_VERSION" ] && exit 0
fi
exec npx @playwright/mcp@latest --headless --isolated --browser chromium
